# Git Exposure Checker

> Free tool: run a CLI that sends two real requests to your site (.git/HEAD and .git/config), then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on whether your .git directory is publicly exposed -- letting anyone reconstruct your full source history, including secrets removed in a later commit.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
